parameters.name: BeginTime
parameters.description: The start timestamp of the query time range. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end timestamp of the query time range. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the instance to which the topic of the message belongs.

parameters.name: MsgId
parameters.description: The ID of the message to query. This is the message ID.

parameters.name: Topic
parameters.description: The topic of the message to query.
